code:
CREATE OR REPLACE CORTEX SEARCH SERVICE support_ticket_search
  ON ticket_text
  ATTRIBUTES ticket_id, product_line, created_at
  WAREHOUSE = cortex_wh
  TARGET_LAG = '1 hour'
  AS (
    SELECT ticket_id, product_line, created_at, ticket_text
    FROM support_tickets
  );
caption: Snowflake manages the index refresh automatically — TARGET_LAG works like a Dynamic Table's schedule.
